title: The 2 Best Electric Can Openers Under $30
h1: The 2 Best Electric Can Openers Under $30
metaDescription: Our 2 picks for electric can openers under $30, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at electric can openers under $30 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Hamilton Beach Smooth Touch Electric Can Opener
products.blurb: Key specs: Typically $25 to $30, Push-down lever, Smooth-edge cutting.
strengths: Typically the least expensive pick here that still includes extra-tall can capacity
Includes a pair of stainless steel scissors as a genuine bonus, not just packaging filler
limitations: No automatic stop or digital feedback of any kind
Basic black-and-chrome finish rather than a premium look
Corded design needs a nearby outlet

products.name: Cuisinart Deluxe Electric Can Opener CCO-50N
products.blurb: Key specs: Typically $35 to $45, Single-touch automatic operation, Nonslip wide base.
strengths: Automatic stop and nonslip base are usually reserved for pricier models
3-year warranty is longer than most budget competitors offer
Worth stretching the budget slightly for the added convenience features
limitations: Bulkier footprint than the more compact budget picks
Fewer long-term reviews than the two cheaper options here

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
